find: lines.push(`**${f.ready.length} ready / ${f.blocked.length} blocked / ${f.unknown.length} unknown**, of ${f.considered} open issues in scope.`);
why: Strips the population from the report's headline. "24 ready" without "of 28" reads as a sweep of the whole backlog rather than of a filtered scope, and this report is filterable by milestone and by label -- so the same three numbers can describe 28 issues or 3. The scope line and this denominator are the only two things telling a reader which. This repository's rules require a population beside every count for exactly this reason.
killedBy: frontier: the rendered report carries the denominator on the headline and the priority/size on each row
